name: Andorra
summary: High-altitude Pyrenean microstate situated between France and Spain. High-elevation valleys preserve pristine mountain air quality with localized tourist traffic peaks.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 1.72x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); alpine valley dispersion keeps particulate levels low.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; Pyrenean winter snowpack duration declining at mid-elevations.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Alpine warming rate across Pyrenean stations over 1994-2023 trailing three decades.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.001% share of global emissions; driven almost entirely by transport fuel and space heating.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Per capita total reflects high commercial tourism transit volume relative to small resident denominator.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Mountain pine and fir forests covering ~160 km² of protected valley and slope terrain.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Domestic production is predominantly Valira river hydroelectricity; imports remainder from France and Spain.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: High-elevation valley population density of 171 people/km².
